# Switch

Instantly toggles a clear on/off state.

## Basic usage

<DemoPreview name="switch" />

## API

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `modelValue` | boolean | false | Updated through v-model |
| `label` | string | Required | Visible label |
| `disabled` | boolean | false | Blocks toggling |
| `name` | string | undefined | Form field name |

### Events

- `update:modelValue(boolean)`

## Keyboard and usage notes

Tab to focus; Space or Enter to toggle.

## Installation

```ts
import { AgmSwitch } from 'augma'
import 'augma/style.css'
```

Copy the editable source:

```sh
pnpm dlx shadcn-vue@2.8.2 add https://augma.yyj.moe/r/switch.json
```
